rationale: Roberts is best positioned to hold the 7-Justice coalition together with a jurisdictional holding finding Missouri standing (via MOHELA-linked fiscal injury) and a narrow merits ruling that the HEROES Act does not clearly authorize mass cancellation under major-questions principles. Sotomayor and Jackson are likely to dissent on standing, while one or more conservatives may write separately to sharpen the standing analysis or emphasize separation-of-powers/major-questions reasoning.
